content: Without server-side schema enforcement, LLMs in JSON mode return syntactically valid but semantically wrong JSON: hallucinated keys, omitted required fields, wrong types, or invented identifiers -- causing silent corruption downstream. Best practice: use tool-use/function-calling (constrained decoding via FSM) to guarantee schema compliance, AND still validate server-side (schema compliance != factual correctness -- a model can emit a syntactically valid building_code that doesn't exist in the DB). Low temperature for extraction tasks. Feed validation errors back to the model on retry rather than failing silently.
